dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing of the 2D footprint from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey skin tone consistent with a sub-adult phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency of dark-pixel clusters; primarily characterized by linear, dark markings rather than diffuse mottling.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast boundaries between the dark linear marks and the lighter grey epidermal base.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark, thin linear scratches (rake marks) are visible on the dorsal surface, particularly on the left-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear epidermal scratches distributed across the dorsal-lateral plane.
